DELIBERATELY NOT REPORTED (seen, judged non-actionable): on p991 item 207 the PDF prints a full stop where a comma belongs - 'USAGE BINARY-SHORT, BINARY-LONG. BINARY-DOUBLE, FLOAT-SHORT, ...' (verified by 300dpi crop). The markdown normalises it to 'BINARY-LONG, BINARY-DOUBLE'. This is a typographical defect in ISO itself that the transcription silently corrected; nothing normative turns on it and 'repairing' the markdown would reintroduce the typo. Recorded here only so a later sweep does not re-litigate it.
